title: log3gpp: Fix read buffer sizing.
description:
Ensure that strlen(protocol.parameters) is included in the requested buffer
size.  Thankfully there's an extra 1024 bytes of spare space allocated by
ws_buffer_assure_space and the maximum protocol parameter string length is 64
characters, so its omission was "safe"...

Also make the buffer size passed to ws_assure_buffer_space from
log3gpp_seek_read vary according to the value of "is_text_data", like it does
for log3gpp_read.

Eliminate a few comments which just repeat what the code is doing.

With log3gpp_read and log3gpp_seek_read becoming a little more self-consistent,
we will soon be able to safely factor the common code from these two functions
into a shared worker function.
